lost_and_found.name: 遺失物取扱所
lost_and_found.description: 深夜零時を過ぎると「少し管轄が広がる」古びた駅舎の窓口。普通の落とし物だけでなく、人々が失くした「想い」も届けられる。
lost_and_found.atmosphere: 薄暗い、古びている、どこか非現実的

imagen_prompt.base: Old Japanese train station lost and found office at night, dim flickering fluorescent lights, aged wooden counter, rusty metal shelves filled with forgotten items, glass door, aroma sticks burning, mysterious atmosphere
imagen_prompt.style: anime style, moody dark lighting, blue and brown tones, rain visible through window

alley.name: 路地裏
alley.description: 怪異化した「声」が潜んでいた場所。雨の夜、薄暗い路地。
alley.atmosphere: 不気味、湿っている、閉塞感

imagen_prompt.base: Dark narrow Japanese back alley at night in rain, wet asphalt reflecting dim lights, old building walls, puddles, rusty emergency stairs, garbage bins, eerie atmosphere
imagen_prompt.style: anime style, dark atmospheric, rain effects, blue-gray tones
imagen_prompt.negative: bright, cheerful, daytime, wide open space

livehouse.name: ライブハウス
livehouse.description: 10年前、澄香が最後のステージに立った小さなライブハウス。20人も入れば満員になる場所。
livehouse.atmosphere: 薄暗い、煙草の煙、緊張感

imagen_prompt.base: Small Japanese underground live house, tiny stage with microphone stand, cheap speakers, dark audience area with about 20 seats, stage lights, cigarette smoke in air, tense atmosphere
imagen_prompt.style: anime style, dramatic stage lighting, nostalgic sepia tones, flashback scene
imagen_prompt.negative: large venue, modern, clean, bright audience

sumika_apartment.name: 澄香のアパート（10年前）
sumika_apartment.description: 24歳の澄香が住んでいた六畳一間のアパート。壁には防音の毛布、窓際に小さなキーボード。
sumika_apartment.atmosphere: 狭い、質素、夢を追う若者の部屋

imagen_prompt.base: Small 6-tatami Japanese apartment room, old blankets on walls for soundproofing, small keyboard by window, scattered sheet music, old phone, cramped but lived-in space of a young aspiring singer
imagen_prompt.style: anime style, warm but dim lighting, nostalgic tones

mother_house.name: 実家
mother_house.description: 澄香の実家。10年間ほとんど変わらず、時間が止まったように古びている。父の遺影がある。
mother_house.atmosphere: 懐かしい、古びている、時間が止まった

imagen_prompt.base: Traditional Japanese house interior, living room with old sofa, father's memorial photo on shelf, faded family photos, ticking clock, aged furniture, atmosphere of time standing still
imagen_prompt.style: anime style, warm soft lighting, muted nostalgic colors

mother_house_entrance.name: 実家の玄関前
mother_house_entrance.description: 実家の玄関前。色褪せた「蒼井」の表札。
mother_house_entrance.atmosphere: 緊張、懐かしさ、変わらない風景

imagen_prompt.base: Japanese house entrance, faded nameplate reading 'Aoi' in Japanese, old intercom button, aged gate, unchanged suburban neighborhood
imagen_prompt.style: anime style, bright daylight, slightly overexposed, nostalgic

station_bench.name: 駅前のベンチ
station_bench.description: 実家の最寄り駅前。澄香が30分も座って動けなかった場所。
station_bench.atmosphere: 緊張、躊躇、日常の中の葛藤

imagen_prompt.base: Japanese suburban train station plaza with bench, ordinary people walking by, station building in background, woman sitting alone on bench looking anxious
imagen_prompt.style: anime style, bright daylight, everyday atmosphere
